# clavis rotation

<p class="cli-lead">Schedule and run secret rotation</p>

<div class="cli-usage">

```sh
clavis rotation <command>
```

</div>

Rotate secrets automatically: a Postgres role password, an AWS IAM
access key, or anything behind your own webhook. The **Rotation** page
in the web app shows the same schedules, runs and errors.
